_readme: PatientWords literacy-sweep pilot. Patient, assistant and sandbox route through OpenRouter (OPENROUTER_API_KEY); the jury stays on the direct Anthropic API (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) because it is the validated instrument and no verified OpenRouter price exists for an Anthropic slug. Run through `python -m patientwords_pab.run`, NOT the upstream console script: agent_class pw_free_trait is registered by importing patientwords_pab, and upstream's entry point does not import it (it raises KeyError first, before any spend). Costed in patientwords-engine/docs/pab_first_probe_costing.md.
